authority.coordination: GitHub issues and pull requests coordinate work but do not prove delivery.
authority.delivery: A repository-local landing-evidence manifest, introduced by issue #12, is the delivery authority.
authority.projection: GitHub Projects v2 and human dashboards are projections of verified repository evidence.

items.title: Reconcile executor landing evidence with main
items.exit_evidence: Draft PR #21 is green, reopens the unlanded executor work, corrects contradictory tracker state, and adds a full-history landing-evidence gate; completion requires human merge admit and a main-reachable merge commit.

items.title: Add canonical Agent Skills SKILL.md export and conformance gate
items.exit_evidence: Draft PR #22 is green: all three current skills have reproducible canonical exports and pass the pinned upstream skills-ref validator; completion requires human merge admit and a main-reachable merge commit.

items.title: Build a SkillsBench task.md adapter with an executable parity gate
items.exit_evidence: Three imported tasks have content-addressed bundles and executable upstream-versus-normalized parity reports.

items.title: Implement a paired randomized replicated Arena experiment runner
items.exit_evidence: One end-to-end paired run emits a signed replayable bundle and all contamination and tamper negative controls pass.

items.title: Establish public calibration and sealed qualification pools
items.exit_evidence: A sealed snapshot is bound before execution and leakage, duplicate, paraphrase, and license negative controls pass.

items.title: Define Arena statistics eligibility gates and ranking policy
items.exit_evidence: Deterministic fixtures reproduce paired estimates, intervals, eligibility states, and aggregation negative controls.

items.title: Add permissive-license supply-chain sandbox and provenance gates
items.exit_evidence: Release and result artifacts pass repository CI, license, SBOM, vulnerability, sandbox-policy, signing, and provenance checks.

items.title: Publish the Arena leaderboard and automate GitHub Projects v2 tracking
items.exit_evidence: A signed JSON and Parquet leaderboard snapshot is published and a closed issue with fabricated evidence cannot become Done in Projects v2.
